remarks: Experience the allure of Newport Beach waterfront living at 605 36th Street, where distinctive architecture, rich natural finishes, and shimmering canal views create an inviting coastal retreat. Designed by architect Bradford C. Smith and extensively remodeled in 2015, this custom residence offers approximately 2,348 square feet with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Reclaimed oak beams, limestone accents, polished concrete floors, and American oak hardwood flooring blend rustic warmth with contemporary sophistication.
